classification.rationale: Potential crafted AI input artifact; supply-chain risk is conditional on delivery to a consumer.

title: HDF5 external reference to a sensitive host path
description: Detects HDF5 external-file constructs alongside sensitive paths; no dependency on a particular hosting provider.
falsepositives: Parser security regression fixtures or authorized adversarial dataset tests.
investigation: Review the generated dataset without loading it in a privileged parser; check server-side file-access telemetry.
